pages.title: Sara's Cooking Class: Red Velvet Cake
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description:
Sara's Cooking Class: Red Velvet Cake guides you through preparing and decorating a layered cake. Find ingredients and utensils in Sara's kitchen, make the mixtures for the batter, and bake the cake. Afterward, prepare cream cheese frosting and cut the cake into layers for filling.

Use the mouse to select the kitchen tools and carry out the cooking actions. The final tasks involve spreading frosting between the layers and around the outside, then finishing the cake with red velvet crumbs and piped cream. The lesson follows the dessert from its separate ingredients to the completed decoration.

pages.title: Smashling
pages.creator: Ahti Poopuu
pages.description: Smashling is a physics puzzle about toppling stacked structures with launched projectiles. Pull back to aim, follow the trajectory guide, and release toward a weak point. Wood, stone, and glass react differently, so choose shots that bring down more of the structure with fewer attempts.

pages.title: Steel Front
pages.creator: DDD6767
pages.description: Steel Front is a World War II shooter with infantry fighting and controllable vehicles. Move through the battlefield, aim weapons, and enter tanks or fighter aircraft for a different approach. Work through the historical campaign's combat situations with your squad.

pages.title: Traffic Racing
pages.creator: Royale Gamers
pages.description: Traffic Racing puts you on a highway filled with vehicles to overtake. Steer through heavy traffic at speed while keeping the car clear of collisions. Choose the career events or take on the online racing league.

pages.title: Clash & Run
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Clash & Run is a running challenge built around jumping across a changing route. Tap to pass obstacles and collect coins for new skins. Boosters such as double jumps or wings can extend the attempt, while a mistake normally ends it unless you revive.

pages.title: Home Block Story
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Home Block Story combines line-clearing puzzles with home renovation. Fit shaped blocks into a board to complete lines and free space for more pieces. Progress through the challenges to unlock decorations and shape the house's appearance.

pages.title: Slippery Drift Racing
pages.creator: Royale Gamers
pages.description: Slippery Drift Racing lets you compete in races or chase a faster time across five maps. Steer into turns and use the handbrake to control a slide. Three difficulty settings change the challenge as you learn the corners.

pages.title: Crazy Bar Brawl
pages.creator: Ultra Games Entertainment Private limited
pages.description: Crazy Bar Brawl puts you in a bar fight where thrown objects do the damage. Use mouse or touch input to aim, then press the throw button to launch an attack. Pick your moment amid the flying furniture and bottles.

pages.title: Challenger City Driver
pages.creator: Fuego! Games
pages.description: Challenger City Driver gives you a muscle car to drive around an open city. Customize the vehicle, use nitro to pass slow traffic, and take on driving challenges with your dog. Complete missions involving speed, stunts, and car control.

pages.title: Idle Money Factory
pages.creator: TopKeyGames
pages.description: Idle Money Factory is a production-management clicker about increasing a factory's output of game money. Improve the machines and production lines, then unlock more sections. Reinvest the earnings to make the operation more efficient and expand its capacity.

pages.title: Puzzle Games: Outing Day
pages.creator: Yiv.Com
pages.description: Puzzle Games: Outing Day follows animal friends on a trip into the countryside. Explore the camp and work through the puzzles connected to their activities. Use the mouse or touch controls to help the group with each short challenge.

pages.title: Draw Climber
pages.creator: VOODOO
pages.description: Draw Climber makes your drawings into a racer's legs. Sketch a shape that can carry the character over the current terrain, then watch it run. Draw a different pair when the existing shape gets stuck on an obstacle.

pages.title: Lava Jump
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Lava Jump sends you across a dungeon filled with lava, moving blocks, and boost pads. Time jumps to avoid spikes and enemies while reaching the next safe platform. Collect coins for additional characters as you work through the levels.

pages.title: Hero Ragdoll Fighting
pages.creator: AdelikDev
pages.description: Hero Ragdoll Fighting puts a weapon-wielding fighter into physics-based combat. Move into battle and defeat opponents in survival waves or campaign stages. Use the available weapons and changing situations to get through each mode's encounters.

pages.title: Cosmo Void
pages.creator: gameVgames
pages.description: Cosmo Void challenges you to pilot a spacecraft through a fast obstacle course. Steer toward gaps, dash through useful openings, and brake when you need more time. Excessive braking can overheat the craft, so use it carefully.

pages.title: Daring Jack
pages.creator: Csharks Games & Solutions Pvt Ltd.
pages.description: Daring Jack follows an adventurer stranded after his plane fails above a jungle island. Explore the surroundings and look for a route to the old boathouse. Find a way to obtain a boat and leave the island.

pages.title: Sword Play! Ninja Slice Runner
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Sword Play! Ninja Slice Runner puts a blade in your control along an action-filled route. Slice through enemies and work past obstacles using mouse or touch input. Keep responding to the targets ahead as the ninja's run continues.

pages.title: Merge Squares
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Merge Squares asks you to place three equal-numbered squares beside one another to create a larger value. Plan where each piece goes to leave useful combinations. Jokers can replace a needed square as you complete the levels' different goals.

pages.title: Bed Wars
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: Bed Wars makes you command a stickman squad while defending your own bed-shaped base. Gather resources, upgrade soldiers and defenses, and attack rival beds. Destroy every enemy base without allowing your own to fall.

pages.title: Sky Balls 3D
pages.creator: gameVgames
pages.description: Sky Balls 3D challenges you to keep a rolling ball on elevated tracks. Avoid traps, gaps, and obstacles while gathering coins and keys for new ball designs or backgrounds. Play the course alone or share a two-player challenge.

pages.title: Idle Hotel Empire
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Idle Hotel Empire lets you develop a hotel by adding floors for different customer needs. Build standard or deluxe rooms and expand into facilities such as cafes, meeting rooms, and pools. Keep growing the property into a larger accommodation business.

pages.title: Candy Rain 8
pages.creator: SOFTGAMES – Mobile Entertainment Services GmbH
pages.description: Candy Rain 8 is a match-three puzzle with candies, waffles, and coin chests to collect. Make useful matches and combine them with boosters to clear the level's requirements. Work through the boards while trying to improve the score on each stage.

pages.title: Zombies Royale Impostor Drive
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Zombies Royale Impostor Drive sends you down a road filled with zombie impostors and obstacles. Run down enemies while keeping the vehicle supplied with fuel and repairs. Avoid road hazards that damage the car and shorten the drive.

pages.title: Coin Clicker
pages.creator: Xenolia
pages.description: Coin Clicker is a simple money-counting clicker. Click to earn virtual currency and use the interface buttons to interact with the game while watching your total increase with repeated taps.

pages.title: Expert Parkour 3D
pages.creator: BestGameSpot
pages.description: Expert Parkour 3D is a platforming challenge about running and jumping between pillars. Judge the distance to each landing and vault past the obstacles on the route. Complete thirty courses while keeping the character from falling.

pages.title: Quick Capture
pages.creator: Brutal Dack Games
pages.description: Quick Capture is a real-time strategy game about expanding across a map. Take lands, villages, and cities while revealing more territory. Move ahead of the opposing force and surround it to gain control of the battlefield.

pages.title: Match Colors Colors Game
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Match Colors challenges you to remove groups of at least three matching dots before time runs out. Tap useful clusters to clear them and meet the level's target. Aim for three stars to earn more coins from your performance.

pages.title: Boom Push
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Boom Push makes you recruit a crowd to push a bomb away from your castle. Gather more people so your group is stronger than the opposition. Keep the explosive moving toward the other side before it reaches your own defenses.

pages.title: Noob Guys
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Noob Guys is an obstacle race between block-world characters. Keep running toward first place and avoid falling, since a fall sends you back to start again. Collect crowns to buy more costumes for your racer.

pages.title: Robox
pages.creator: magnificstudios
pages.description: Robox follows a robot trying to reach an exit door through traps and enemies. Run, jump, and shoot boxes with a teleportation gun to solve the route. Work out how the boxes can help you reach the next safe platform.

pages.title: Squid Marble Game
pages.creator: Meyagames
pages.description: Squid Marble Game challenges you to aim a marble into a hole. Swipe to line up the shot and judge the launch so the marble reaches its target. A miss eliminates you from the attempt across the game's fifty levels.

pages.title: Word Guess
pages.creator: Gamealliz
pages.description: Word Guess gives you six attempts to identify a hidden word. Enter a guess and use the feedback showing which letters are present and correctly positioned. Narrow the possibilities with each response before the attempts run out.

pages.title: Summer Fashion Makeover
pages.creator: iclickgames
pages.description: Summer Fashion Makeover lets you help Lily prepare for a return to the beach. Work through the makeover and appearance choices to refresh her summer look. Combine the available styling options before she heads out again.

pages.title: Dibbles 2. Winter Woes
pages.creator: Podge Games
pages.description: Dibbles 2: Winter Woes asks you to get a king safely across the North Pole. Place command stones along the route to assign jobs to the Dibbles. The first follower reaching a stone carries out the order, even when it means sacrificing itself.

pages.title: I Am Flying to the Moon
pages.creator: Elite Games Ltd
pages.description: I Am Flying To The Moon lets you launch a wooden rocket and try to travel farther on each flight. Steer through the air and collect money or upgrades. Improve the rocket so later launches can carry it closer to the Moon.

pages.title: Apple Worm
pages.creator: Gibton
pages.description: Apple Worm is a movement puzzle about bending a worm through tight spaces. Reach the apple, then guide the longer body toward the black-hole exit. Plan around the shape of the platforms so the worm does not become stranded.

pages.title: Pig Ball impostor
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Pig Ball Impostor follows a round pig through a forest filled with square impostors. Jump onto monsters to defeat them and use double jumps to pass difficult sections. Collect the three stars required to advance to the next level.

pages.title: Celestial Fall
pages.creator: Wanted 5 Games B.V.
pages.description: Celestial Fall challenges you to guide Magda downward without landing on spikes. Click to turn left or right and choose a safer descent. Collect abilities that can rearrange the world while trying to reach a lower depth.

pages.title: Pinball Clash
pages.creator: All Correct Group Limited
pages.description: Pinball Clash turns a pinball table into a contest against another player or the computer. Use the flippers to send the ball through bumpers, ramps, and spinners. Compete in tournaments and work toward a better leaderboard position.

pages.title: Funny Camping Day
pages.creator: iclickgames
pages.description: Funny Camping Day follows friends taking part in activities at a summer camp. Clean the campsite, put up tents, try fishing, and light a campfire. Complete the different outdoor tasks as you switch between the group's characters.

pages.title: Fairy Puzzle
pages.creator: Eponesh.Technologies
pages.description: Fairy Puzzle offers fifty jigsaw challenges with large pieces and colorful scenes. Rebuild pictures of knights, dragons, castles, pirates, and other subjects by placing their sections correctly. Complete one illustration before moving on to the next puzzle.

pages.title: Coloring Gorgels
pages.creator: WPG Kindermedia
pages.description: Coloring Gorgels gives you illustrated characters to color with different drawing modes. Work freely, keep strokes inside the lines, or use automatic fill. Choose pencils and colors, then download or print the completed artwork.

pages.title: Shaun The Sheep Baahmy Golf
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Shaun The Sheep Baahmy Golf turns the farm into a golf course filled with objects to hit. Set the shot's angle and power, then use flippers while the ball is moving. Smash obstacles for points and reach the hole within five attempts.

pages.title: Jumping Whooper
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Jumping Whooper is an endless jumping game starring a burger. Tap to clear ketchup bottles, hats, and other obstacles on the route. The speed changes unpredictably, so keep adjusting the timing of your jumps.

pages.title: Among Them Bubble Shooter
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Among Them Bubble Shooter asks you to clear a field of colored bubbles. Aim and release a shot to form matching groups of at least three. Finish the twenty-four boards with as few shots as possible.

pages.title: Bumper.io
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Bumper.io puts you in an arena where attacks can turn smaller rivals into opportunities to grow stronger. Move to find a favorable opponent, then release the movement control to attack. Survive the exchanges while improving your position in the battle.

pages.title: Dragon Simulator 3D
pages.creator: CyberGoldfinch
pages.description: Dragon Simulator 3D lets you control a dragon with powers based on fire, ice, nature, or air. Explore the environment, fly, and use ranged or melee attacks against threats. Choose a dragon and test its abilities against creatures and armed humans.

pages.title: Alex The Alien
pages.creator: Joypad Media
pages.description: Alex The Alien follows a lost visitor trying to return to his spaceship. Click to jump, collect every gold coin, and avoid spikes to open the next portal. Travel through fifty levels across three worlds to complete the return journey.

pages.title: Bounce Balls
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Bounce Balls puts a cannon against bouncing balls with durability to wear down. Keep firing to destroy them and collect coins from your progress. Spend the money on upgrades and new appearances as the ball waves become harder.

pages.title: Speedway Racing
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Speedway Racing puts stock cars onto oval tracks for wheel-to-wheel competition. Steer through the bends and manage your position against the other drivers. Keep a smooth line around the course while working toward the front of the race.

pages.title: Tank Mayhem
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Tank Mayhem is a tank duel against a friend or the computer. Move through the arena, aim shots, and collect bonuses that strengthen your attack. The mini-tank drone can pursue the opponent or crash into it when a direct hit fails.

pages.title: Ninja War
pages.creator: Gamesdev
pages.description: Ninja War sends a ninja into fights with other ninjas for points. Jump past danger and throw blades at opponents, collecting hearts to restore health. Gathering three blades releases a larger attack against the enemies ahead.

pages.title: Park Master 2
pages.creator: BestGames
pages.description: Park Master 2 is a route-drawing parking puzzle. Draw a line from each car toward its parking place, then let the vehicles follow your plan. Keep the paths clear of obstacles and time their movement to avoid collisions.

pages.title: Squamp
pages.creator: Yliaw Mission
pages.description: Squamp is a two-player jumping contest on a course of moving obstacles. Guide your character with the assigned keys and avoid the hazards while staying in play. Try to outlast the other player as the course becomes faster.

pages.title: Crazy Monster Trucks Memory
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Crazy Monster Trucks Memory asks you to find matching truck pictures hidden beneath cards. Turn over two at a time and remember the unmatched positions. Clear all pairs across four levels while trying to finish with fewer moves.

pages.title: Space Attack
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Space Attack puts you on defense against incoming asteroids. Aim and shoot to destroy the space rocks before they strike you or the planet. Keep clearing the approaching threats so the defense can continue.

pages.title: Xmas Pipes
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Xmas Pipes asks you to arrange a pipeline that carries Christmas presents to a tree. Click a pipe section to rotate it and line up its openings. Complete a connected route so every gift can reach the destination.

pages.title: Tap Tap Car
pages.creator: Flick Gamer
pages.description: Tap Tap Car makes you release cars from a parking area without blocking traffic. Watch the nearby vehicles and tap a car when its route is safe. Change the camera view if another angle helps you judge the exit.

pages.title: Fisherman
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Fisherman lets you cast a hook and collect fish in different environments. Time the cast to reach your catch, then bring the fish back and check its weight. Sell caught fish to build the game's coin total.

pages.title: Slide io
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Slide.io is a race along a twisting water-slide course. Steer through the bends, keep control when the route sends you airborne, and compete with the other riders. Reach the finish ahead while avoiding a fall from the course.

pages.title: BMW 2 Series Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: BMW 2 Series Puzzle offers six car pictures as jigsaw challenges. Choose among sixteen, thirty-six, sixty-four, or one hundred pieces, then place the sections correctly. Use the vehicle's details and picture edges to rebuild the image.

pages.title: Call On Duty Sniper Assassin
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Call On Duty Sniper Assassin puts you into shooting missions in a military setting. Use the mouse to line up the weapon and fire at targets. Work through the combat assignments while trying to make each shot count.

pages.title: Racing Jump
pages.creator: Ricreator
pages.description: Racing Jump is a physics-based race with bouncing characters. Click or press the space bar to control jumps across the course toward the finish. Watch for bombs and gunfire that can interrupt your progress.

pages.title: Brick Breaker 2018
pages.creator: Black Sheep Games
pages.description: Brick Breaker 2018 asks you to keep a ball in play with a moving paddle. Send it into the bricks to break the layout, collecting power-ups when they fall. Destroy every remaining brick to advance to the next level.

pages.title: Frozen Princess Hidden Object
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Frozen Princess Hidden Object sends you through a castle searching for a princess's missing accessories. Find makeup, ribbons, bags, shoes, and other fashion items among the scenery. Collect the requested objects so she can prepare for the winter party.

pages.title: Bubble Shooter Classic
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Bubble Shooter Classic is an ongoing color-matching shooting game. Aim the loaded bubble toward others of the same color and release it into the field. Keep forming matching groups to clear bubbles and create openings for the next shot.

pages.title: Helicopter Shooter
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Helicopter Shooter puts you in control of an armed helicopter. Fly through the combat area and shoot down enemy targets for points. Steer around the threats while continuing to fire so the score can keep growing.

pages.title: Restaurant and Cooking
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Restaurant And Cooking puts you in charge of preparing customer orders. Assemble the requested food and deliver it before the customer's patience runs out. Manage the ingredients and side requests while earning enough to meet the career targets.

pages.title: Antique Cars Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Antique Cars Puzzle provides six pictures of vintage vehicles to assemble. Select an image and a piece count between sixteen and one hundred, then drag the pieces into place. Complete the picture at your preferred difficulty before choosing another car.

pages.title: Babysitter Crazy Daycare
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Babysitter Crazy Daycare lets you look after babies through several care activities. Feed them, give them a bath, help them sleep, or work through tooth-brushing and play routines. Choose a baby and complete the selected daycare task.

pages.title: The Fishercat Online
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: The Fishercat Online casts a cat as an underwater hunter using harpoons. Aim at different fish and try equipment or items that change the fishing approach. Encounter a range of species as you build the catch.

pages.title: Vegas Crime City
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Vegas Crime City is an action game with ten levels and several weapons. Move around the city, aim and fire, and switch equipment when needed. Running, jumping, and rolling give you ways to reposition during the combat.

pages.title: Lamborghini Car Drift
pages.creator: GameBiz
pages.description: Lamborghini Car Drift gives you a sports car to drive with keyboard controls. Steer, accelerate, and brake as you explore the driving area. Practice controlling the car through turns and try different ways to handle its movement.

pages.title: EG Halloween Defender
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: EG Halloween Defender puts pumpkins under attack from floating Halloween skulls. Shoot at the skulls before they can eat the pumpkins below. Keep directing fire toward the approaching threats to preserve the remaining pumpkin patch.

pages.title: Candy Blast Match 3
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Candy Blast Match 3 asks you to swap neighboring sweets into matching rows. Line up at least three candies of the same color to remove them. Look for combinations that open more matches as the field changes.

pages.title: Anna Scoliosis Surgery
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Anna Scoliosis Surgery is a fictional surgery simulation featuring Princess Anna. Follow the on-screen procedure and select the available tools as the appointment progresses. Complete the game's treatment steps to finish the character's medical-care activity.

pages.title: Dino Meat Hunt Remastered
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Dino Meat Hunt Remastered makes two dinosaurs cooperate to collect meat and reach their cages. The small dinosaur can create bridges over water, while the larger one can extinguish fire. Use their different abilities to solve the route together.

pages.title: Zombie Road
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Zombie Road puts a vehicle on a dangerous road with obstacles and pickups. Steer away from collisions while watching the car's health and fuel. Gather supplies and extend the drive to increase your score.

pages.title: Car Wash Salon
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Car Wash Salon lets you clean a selection of twenty-two vehicles. Choose a car, truck, tractor, or another vehicle and work through the washing activity. Clear the dirt to reveal the cleaned bodywork before trying another model.

pages.title: Gladiator Simulator
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Gladiator Simulator puts you in an arena with a choice of five weapons, including a shield. Move into combat and use the equipment against the opposition. Try the two available arena maps while developing your approach to the fights.

pages.title: Fairy House Cleaning
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Fairy House Cleaning follows a fairy preparing her home before guests arrive. Enter each of the three rooms and complete the cleaning chores. Clear the mess and put the house in order before the visitors see it.

pages.title: Unblock That
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Unblock That is a sliding-block puzzle about opening an escape route for the target piece. Shift the other blocks along their allowed directions to clear the path. Plan the sequence carefully across boards with different difficulty settings.

pages.title: Blossom Garden Crush
pages.creator: BestGames
pages.description: Blossom Garden Crush is a flower-clearing puzzle set in a colorful garden. Slide the pieces to form matching arrangements and remove flowers from the board. Work through the changing layouts and challenges as you continue the matching activity.

pages.title: Love Balls 2
pages.creator: BestGames
pages.description: Love Balls 2 asks you to reunite two separated balls by drawing a line. Use the shape you create to influence their movement through the scene. Plan around gravity and obstacles so the two characters can roll together.

pages.title: Super Soccer Stars
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Super Soccer Stars offers football matches in solo, two-player, and tournament modes. Move into position, defend your goal, and send the ball past the opposing side. Choose a mode and compete to finish the match ahead.

pages.title: Fireboy and Watergirl 3 Ice Temple
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Fireboy And Watergirl 3 Ice Temple follows two characters through an icy puzzle platformer. Use their different abilities to work through the temple and reach the exits. Keep Fireboy out of water and Watergirl away from fire while coordinating their movements.

pages.title: Traffic Rush 2018
pages.creator: webofgrafix
pages.description: Traffic Rush 2018 challenges you to drive safely through a crowded lane. Watch other cars and adjust your route to avoid collisions. A single crash ends the attempt, so steady control matters as the traffic closes in.

pages.title: World Football Kick 2018
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: World Football Kick 2018 lets you choose a country and compete in a World Cup penalty challenge. Aim each shot to send the ball into the goal. Keep scoring to help your selected team progress through the football competition.

pages.title: Ball&Roll
pages.creator: FluffyFoxGames
pages.description: Ball&Roll challenges you to guide a ball past traps and moving saws. Use touch or mouse control to keep its movement clear of danger while collecting coins. Spend the coins on additional balls for later attempts.

pages.title: Goldie Baby Bath Care
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Goldie Baby Bath Care follows a baby's morning washing and dressing routine. Add bubbles and toys to the bath, wash Goldie's hair, and continue with powder or baby oil. Finish the care activity by choosing an outfit.

pages.title: Minigolf World
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Minigolf World offers eighteen holes with obstacles to work around. Set the ball's direction and shot strength, then aim to reach the cup in fewer strokes. Use the shape of each course to plan more accurate attempts.

pages.title: Mahjong
pages.creator: DevilishGames
pages.description: Mahjong challenges you to clear a tile board by finding matching pairs. Select two identical tiles of the same type and remove them from the layout. Finish the available matches before the timer runs out.

pages.title: Save The Chickens
pages.creator: Ixel Games
pages.description: Save The Chickens puts a truck full of chickens on a journey to the finish. Control the vehicle carefully over the route so fewer passengers fall away. Try to reach the end with as many chickens still aboard as possible.

pages.title: Silly Ways To Die 3
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Silly Ways To Die 3 turns a construction site into a collection of survival challenges. Catch bricks, avoid falling objects, fill holes, or climb ladders to keep the workers alive. React to the task shown in each short scene.

pages.title: I want to be a Billionaire 2
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: I Want To Be A Billionaire 2 is a business-management game about growing your net worth. Buy businesses, improve their earning capacity, and use the available money to expand. Balance further purchases with upgrades to develop the city's business portfolio.

pages.title: Angela Twins Birth
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Angela Twins Birth follows Talking Angela preparing for the arrival of two kittens. Help her while she waits for the ambulance, then continue the fictional hospital and baby-care activities. Change the twins' diapers and feed them as part of the routine.
